chatbot.welcome: Hello! I am your AI farming assistant. How can I help you today with your crops or weather planning?

responses.rain: Our models predict a 20% deficit in rainfall for the upcoming monsoon. Ensure your rainwater harvesting systems are ready.
responses.crop: For this season, I highly recommend planting Drought-Resistant Sorghum, as it has a 92% viability match with our climate forecasts.
